desc:
I'M WITH THE SCIENCE TEAM!

fight your fellow ragdolly scientist crew in rounds, punching and kicking and making sure that you're the last scientist on the map! earn points by winning to get new skins for your scientist and new throwable objects while you spectate! 

you can play against bots, or play in a server with other people, it's up to you. you can also play in the sandbox mode and mess around!

should work on PC, console, and mobile
BASED OFF OF THE GARRY'S MOD/GMOD GAMEMODE "Ragdoll Combat."
